_note: Strongest per stack, fades fast, half as effective against shields. Ticks twice a second; loses 5% of its stacks (rounded up) each tick. Numbers are placeholders.
name: Burn

_note: Never fades; hits shields; each stack lowers the target's DEF by 1.
name: Bleed

_note: Can't move; can still attack and cast. Snares (Trapper Maren) and Drag (Bog Lurker) root.
name: Root

_note: Can't move, attack, or fire a mana signature; mana still comes in, and other signature triggers still fire (decided). A push stopped short stuns for collision_stun_ms.
name: Stun

_note: Moves and attacks slow_bp slower. Slows don't stack: the strongest on a unit wins.
name: Slow

_note: The unit's target becomes whoever taunted it, for as long as it lasts; a newer Taunt wins. Hold the Line taunts for 3s.
name: Taunt

_note: No mana gain while it lasts (the Gloam Witch's Hush). Units without mana ignore it.
name: Silence

_note: Takes damage_taken_bp more damage from every source (Marking Shot: +15% for 4s). Marks don't stack: the strongest wins.
name: Marked

_note: Its HP can't drop below 1 while it lasts; each save is logged. Brannoc's 'can't fall for 1s' when he hits 1 HP; Last Rites gives it for 3s.
name: Undying

_note: Held by an engager: can't move until it breaks free (break_free_ms in tuning.json). Only the Engage trait sets and clears it; effects can't apply it.
name: Engaged

_note: No enemy can pick it as a target while it lasts, and one already targeting it picks again. Shots already flying and areas still hit it, and it keeps attacking. Maren's Slip Away gives it for 1s after each hop (playtest gate 1).
name: Stealth

_note: Takes damage_reduced_bp less damage from hits and damage over time (Wardweaver's Warding Circle, phase 4). Wards don't stack: the strongest wins, and it adds to a Mark.
name: Warded

_note: Each stack takes 1 DEF off, never fades, and deals no damage (Sunder, an epic relic; phase 5c step 5a).
name: Sunder
